invoice_clauses.10.1: Each invoice quotes the contract number on the face of this Base Agreement and carries an invoice number unique across the term.
invoice_clauses.10.2: Every Service Date falls within the term and may not fall after the invoice date.
invoice_clauses.10.3: The same Service may not be billed twice for the same Patient and Service Date, whether on one invoice or across several.

conventions.base 1.3: This Base Agreement is to be read together with Appendix B (Rate Schedule) and with any amendment executed under clause 1.4. In the event of conflict, an amendment prevails over Appendix B, and Appendix B prevails over this Base Agreement.
conventions.base 1.4: The Parties may amend the rates and the list of contracted Services by a numbered amendment executed by both Parties. An amendment states its own effective date and the basis on which that date operates.
conventions.base 1.5: The Provider delivers the Services from Main Campus (F-MAIN). No facility differential applies, and all plan tiers are reimbursed identically.
conventions.base 2.1: "Service Day" means the calendar day recorded as the Service Date of the line item.
conventions.base 2.2: "Business Day" means any Service Day other than a Saturday or a Sunday.
conventions.base 3.1: All monetary amounts are expressed in whole cents. Where the application of a multiplier, premium or discount produces a fraction of a cent, the result shall be rounded to the nearest whole cent, with exact halves rounded away from zero ("half up"). Rounding is applied after each individual step of the calculation, not once at the end.
conventions.base 3.2: Where more than one adjustment applies to the same Service, the adjustments shall be applied to the base rate strictly in the following order: (a) substitution of a bundled rate; (b) the facility multiplier; (c) the plan-tier multiplier; (d) any premium or uplift; and (e) any cumulative volume discount. The line total is then the resulting unit rate multiplied by the billed quantity.
conventions.base 3.3: The line total is the effective unit rate multiplied by the billed quantity; the invoice total is the sum of the line totals.
conventions.base 4.1: A threshold premium is assessed against the aggregate quantity of the Service delivered to the Patient on the Service Day.
conventions.base 6.1: Cumulative utilisation is counted cumulatively across the whole term of this Agreement and aggregated across all Patients, in Service Date order, up to but excluding the line item being priced; where two line items share a Service Date they are counted in ascending order of line identifier. Where two thresholds are met the deeper discount applies.
conventions.base 8.1: Bundled rates replace the Appendix B rates for both Services whenever the pair is delivered to the same Patient on the same Service Day, and are substituted before any premium or discount.
conventions.amendment A1.1.2: This Amendment applies **by Service Date**. A line item whose Service Date falls on or after the effective date is priced under this Amendment; a line item whose Service Date falls before the effective date is priced under Appendix B. The date on which an invoice is issued is irrelevant for this purpose.
conventions.amendment A1.4.1: Save as expressly amended by this Amendment, the Base Agreement and Appendix B continue in full force. In particular, the premiums, caps, bundles, exclusion windows and calculation conventions in the Base Agreement are unchanged, and apply to the substituted rates in the same way as they applied to the rates they replace.
conventions.amendment A1.4.2: Nothing in this Amendment affects an invoice already settled before the effective date.
